raw_response:
I farm 10.1 mu, not a big place, so I count every bag. What I do is mostly what has held up around here in good years. I do not like cutting fertilizer too hard, because if wheat or maize gets hungry at the wrong time, that loss is bigger than wasting a little money on one extra bag. I will keep the full 10.1 mu in the wheat-maize rotation like usual. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put most of the phosphate on early, keep nitrogen steady, and water with my well about three times if the weather does not help. For maize, I will plant hybrid seed, feed it a bit heavier on nitrogen than wheat, and give two waters if rain is short. I will rotary till because that is what I can manage on this land without too much extra cost. I watch the neighbors too; if everyone nearby is feeding wheat and maize well, I will not be the one to save a little money and lose grain.
